an8.87:1.1: “Bhikkhus, the Saṅgha may, if it wishes, turn the bowl upside down for a lay follower on eight grounds.
an8.87:1.3: They try to prevent the bhikkhus from getting material things. They try to harm bhikkhus. They try to drive bhikkhus from a monastery. They insult and abuse bhikkhus. They divide bhikkhus against each other. They criticize the Buddha, the teaching, and the Saṅgha.
an8.87:1.4: The Saṅgha may, if it wishes, turn the bowl upside down for a lay follower on these eight grounds.
an8.87:2.1: The Saṅgha may, if it wishes, turn the bowl upright for a lay follower on eight grounds.
an8.87:2.3: They don’t try to prevent the bhikkhus from getting material things. They don’t try to harm bhikkhus. They don’t try to drive bhikkhus from a monastery. They don’t insult and abuse bhikkhus. They don’t divide bhikkhus against each other. They don’t criticize the Buddha, the teaching, and the Saṅgha.
an8.87:2.4: The Saṅgha may, if it wishes, turn the bowl upright for a lay follower on these eight grounds.”
